rows.quote: Validation was performed using stroke cohorts from the UKB (6116 cases, 456,817 controls) and the FinnGen R10 release (43,132 cases, 297,867 controls).
rows.coder_note: Sentence names 'the FinnGen R10 release' as the validation stroke dataset; the endpoint counts (340,999 in all) are an endpoint-specific N and equal no other release's N (rule H); no other passage names a release.

The UKB stroke dataset is given only as 'stroke cohorts from the UKB (6116 cases, 456,817 controls)': exact counts with a cohort name, no accession, citation, pipeline or phenotype definition (rule I1); details are deferred to Table S1, which is not given.
